content: shadcn/ui (already in ParseForge's stack) is designed around exactly this Tailwind v4 CSS-variable theming model -- components consume semantic tokens (--primary, --background, --border, --sidebar-*, --chart-1..5) defined once and overridden per-mode. A ParseForge dark-gaming redesign should extend the existing shadcn token set (add e.g. --accent-warband, --rarity-epic tokens) rather than hand-writing new component-level classes, preserving upgradability of shadcn components.
